ai_review.review: The lone review does not comment on the audio fidelity, mix, or musical execution; it merely points out that this tape is not Dick's Pick volume 4 (which features the February 13‑14 1970 Fillmore East shows). The reviewer gave a zero‑star rating, indicating dissatisfaction with the misidentification rather than the recording itself.
